service.method: SELECT LANG.CONTENTS AS CONTENTS_#LANGUAGE# , GRID.HOUSE_CODE , GRID.GRID_ID , GRID.CODE , GRID.MODULE , GRID.COL_TYPE , #DB_OWNER#NVL(GRID.NOT_NULL, 0) NOT_NULL , GRID.COL_FORMAT , GRID.TEXT_STYLE , GRID.TEMPLATE , LANG.GRID_WIDTH AS COL_WIDTH_#LANGUAGE# , GRID.COL_MAX_LEN , GRID.COL_ALIGN , GRID.COL_VISIBLE , GRID.SELECTED_YN , GRID.COL_SEQ , GRID.COL_COLOR , GRID.COL_COMBO , GRID.COL_SORT , 'Y' SAVED FROM SGRID GRID LEFT OUTER JOIN SLANG LANG ON GRID.HOUSE_CODE = LANG.HOUSE_CODE AND GRID.GRID_ID = LANG.SCREEN_ID AND GRID.CODE = LANG.CODE AND LANG.LANGUAGE = ${LANGUAGE} WHERE GRID.GRID_ID = ${GRID_ID} AND GRID.HOUSE_CODE = '000' AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(LANG.HOUSE_CODE, '000') = #DB_OWNER#NVL((SELECT max(HOUSE_CODE) FROM SLANG WHERE HOUSE_CODE = '000' AND SCREEN_ID = LANG.SCREEN_ID AND CODE = LANG.CODE AND LANGUAGE = LANG.LANGUAGE ), '000') AND ( 1=1 AND upper(GRID.CODE) like '%' + upper($S{F_KEYWORD}) + '%' OR upper(LANG.CONTENTS) like '%' + upper($S{F_KEYWORD}) + '%' ) ORDER BY GRID.COL_SEQ, CODE

INSERT INTO #DB_OWNER#SGRID ( HOUSE_CODE, GRID_ID, CODE, MODULE, COL_TYPE, COL_FORMAT, COL_MAX_LEN, COL_ALIGN, COL_VISIBLE, SELECTED_YN, COL_SEQ, TEXT_STYLE, COL_COLOR, COL_COMBO, COL_SORT, ADD_USER_ID, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, CHANGE_USER_ID, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, DEL_FLAG, NOT_NULL, TEMPLATE ) VALUES ( '000', ${GRID_ID}, ${CODE}, ${MODULE}, ${COL_TYPE}, ${COL_FORMAT}, ${COL_MAX_LEN}, ${COL_ALIGN}, ${COL_VISIBLE}, ${SELECTED_YN}, ${COL_SEQ}, ${TEXT_STYLE}, ${COL_COLOR}, ${COL_COMBO}, ${COL_SORT}, ${session.ID}, ${current.DATE}, ${current.TIME}, ${session.ID}, ${current.DATE}, ${current.TIME}, 'N', ${NOT_NULL}, ${TEMPLATE} )

INSERT INTO #DB_OWNER#SLANG ( HOUSE_CODE, SCREEN_ID, LANGUAGE, CODE, CONTENTS, GRID_WIDTH, ADD_USER_ID, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, CHANGE_USER_ID, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, DEL_FLAG ) VALUES ( '000', ${GRID_ID}, ${LANGUAGE}, ${CODE}, ${CONTENTS}, ${COL_WIDTH}, ${session.ID}, ${current.DATE}, ${current.TIME}, ${session.ID}, ${current.DATE}, ${current.TIME}, 'N' )
SELECT CODE ,LANGUAGE ,CONTENTS ,GRID_WIDTH FROM SLANG WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SCREEN_ID = ${GRID_ID} AND LANGUAGE = ${LANGUAGE}
